title: An equation is a claim you can test

ask.text: Load every charge that locks the span.

hints.text: Two pans across the Sill, and a deck that still has to reach.
Seat each charge in turn and watch the Sill. Only a level Sill locks it.
The far pan is holding 7 and the near pan is a charge plus 2.

worldFraming.text: You are standing on the result either way.

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: Two pans across the Sill, and a deck that still has to reach.
Read down the working. One line does not follow from the one above it.
Line 2 is where the load stops matching.

worldFraming.text: You are standing on the result either way.

ask.text: Author a claim on this site that closes at 3.

hints.text: Two pans across the Sill, and a deck that still has to reach.
The far pan is the site. You are authoring the near one.
Whatever you write, seating 3 has to leave the Sill level.
